name: NZP Mobilized iOS 0.3.0 P2P test - unsigned, no relay
body:
## Direct internet P2P test, with no relay
This candidate adds online room browsing and direct peer-to-peer connection attempts. Some carrier, symmetric-NAT or UDP-blocking networks may not connect because no relay is configured. Different-network Android-to-iPhone gameplay has not been verified.

**This iOS 0.3.0 (build 3) IPA is unsigned and requires your own signing/install process before it can run on an iPhone.** Bundle org.nzp.mobile.ios.preview is unchanged. Use matching [Android 0.7.0-p2p-test/code 7](https://github.com/itssnotTristan/NZP-Mobile/releases/tag/android-v7) for the paired protocol.

### Changes and use
- Multiplayer → Host Game starts a foreground four-player Nacht co-op host and lists it online. Join Game lists rooms and attempts a direct connection. Nearby LAN remains separate.
- The fixed public directory/signaling service is already configured. It lists room names/player counts and exchanges short-lived private ICE descriptions over HTTPS; it does not relay gameplay.
- Gameplay uses FTE ICE/UDP and mutually pinned DTLS, with OpenSSL built from pinned source.
- iOS menu controls move into a bottom dock, and shared menus fit within the available content area.
- Zombie/dog movement restores the prior movement mask so foreign limb/corpse hitboxes do not obstruct their bodies. This is a reproduced collision repair, not proof that the earlier screenshot's specific behavior is resolved.
- Stance below rounds, names, aim slowdown, prior gameplay fixes and platform-specific update checks carry forward.

Keep the host app open and foregrounded. Guest controls retain manual tap-fire fallback. Host migration, relay fallback and background hosting are not provided.

### Verification limits
Portable/native/QuakeC checks and the Android build/signing checks passed. The actual Xcode 27 arm64 compile/link/package and artifact upload passed in [run 37574457786](https://github.com/itssnotTristan/NZP-Mobile/actions/runs/37574457786). Independent downloaded-IPA verification matched all 1,175 game files, both HUD images and all 12 notices to the exact paired source, and confirmed strong real audio, FTE ICE, P2P, DTLS and OpenSSL linkage. The transport proof covers actual FTE ICE/DTLS challenge packets between two local processes with a test address adapter. It is not a full game sign-on or a cross-network phone playtest. Phone gameplay, audio, menu layout, frame pacing and multiplayer acceptance remain pending.

### Files and complete source
Unsigned IPA: NZP-Mobile-iOS-unsigned.ipa
Bytes: 113893871
SHA-256: 4dcfbf9815216e4a1bed9e2a1fd2f98e70ada9a829c3ad3d06b0353551b41ac6

Complete paired source: NZP-Mobilized-P2P-paired-source-final.zip
Bytes: 198422204
SHA-256: e53a12207f9254cd15110ead50efd6d33acee1e6afcb71eec5fe78b8744f953f

Use the attached named source ZIP for both platform source trees, matching content, pinned dependencies, build instructions and component license/credit files. GitHub's automatic source archives are not the complete corresponding source. No private signing material is included. The frozen archive records its pre-Apple-build status; the successful run and independent artifact checks stated here are the newer evidence.

iOS requires ARM64 with a deployment target of iOS 15. iOS build 2 can identify this newer iOS release and open its page, but signing/install remain manual. The original iOS build 1 has no updater. No Apple credentials or signing keys are included, and no Quest work is included.

Unofficial NZ:P mobile port. Upstream NZ:P, id Tech/FTE and other component credits/licenses are retained; this is a mixed-license project.

name: NZP Mobilized iOS 0.2.0 MP1 test - unsigned, same-Wi-Fi LAN
body:
iOS 0.2.0 (build 2), bundle org.nzp.mobile.ios.preview, displayed as NZP Mobilized.

**This IPA is unsigned. It requires your own signing/install process before it can run on an iPhone. No Apple credentials or signing keys are included. The original iOS v1 has no in-game updater, so download this update directly.**

IPA: NZP-Mobile-iOS-unsigned.ipa
Bytes: 111678472
SHA-256: dac2b175ee88405ab4eb7a174247eb15d7594974681494f3741773b892ab0e1b

Built for ARM64 with Xcode 27, deployment target iOS 15.0. The new update check can identify later iOS builds and open their release page, but installation still requires signing.

Paired Android: [Android 0.6.0 MP1 test](https://github.com/itssnotTristan/NZP-Mobile/releases/tag/android-v6).

## Same-Wi-Fi LAN test only
Host Game and Join Game browse nearby hosts on the same Wi-Fi. Internet matchmaking, NAT traversal and relay are not ready. This paired test still needs real Android-to-iPhone playtesting.

### Paired changes
- Stance sits below the round counter on both platforms; player names persist and can be renamed.
- Foreground Host Game starts a four-slot Nacht co-op test; Join Game uses nearby discovery and a live compatibility/status check. Use the matching MP1 builds on both phones.
- Off/Low/Normal touch aim slowdown checks living, visible zombies; it does not snap or fire.
- Fixes target game-over/death handling, pause menus, live zombie/dog collision bounds and rejected weapon swaps.
- iOS now links the actual SDL audio output driver, with interruption recovery.
- Update checks use validated, platform-specific published artifacts. Offline/service failure does not establish an outdated app. Android and iOS build numbers are independent.

Guest controls use manual tap fire for this initial protocol; automatic hold-fire, toggle ADS and held sprint remain host-only. Keep the hosting phone foregrounded. There is no host migration or background-hosting guarantee.

### Verification and limits
Android's full build, source/content checks and retained-key signing passed. The matching iOS arm64 build passed Xcode 27, compile/link/package, and downloaded-byte verification in [run 37559756396](https://github.com/itssnotTristan/NZP-Mobile/actions/runs/37559756396). All 1,175 iOS game files and both HUD images match the frozen paired source; its binary contains the strong real audio driver.

Physical-phone gameplay, audible iOS playback, multi-phone co-op, frame pacing and the reported crash/fix behavior still need device testing. These are test candidates, not a claim that those runtime issues are resolved. Quest work has not started.

### Complete corresponding source
The attached NZP-Mobilized-MP1-paired-source-final.zip contains both complete source trees, matching game content, build inputs, and component credits/licenses. Use this ZIP rather than GitHub's automatic source archives. The frozen source README records the pre-build state; the successful Apple run and packaged-content checks above are the newer build evidence.

SHA-256: 8acfd7761ed5445da198e753cc2d2ffc70b864c5ad81c6fba6e8d68a7685d02e

name: NZP Mobile 0.4.0 Preview - HUD and performance test
body:
## Mobile test preview

Unofficial NZ:P Android 0.4.0-preview for HUD and performance testing. Phone acceptance is pending. Internet multiplayer is unfinished, and no Quest work is included.

## HUD and controls

- Remove the original "press E to use" prompt under the touch-use button
- Move points to the top-left under pause, with round information below
- Remove duplicated original ammo, tactical and grenade counters
- Show larger power-up indicators at the top-center
- Add sprint when the forward movement gesture passes above the hollow ring
- Correct HUD metadata across game code and Android controls

## Performance investigation

The revised build corrects a finite initial limb-pool reference defect that left 72 reserved entities stranded in the audited setup. It also removes three of every four redundant limb-model setter calls in the test fixture (6,240 to 1,560 calls with 13 zombies).

These are code-level test results. They do not establish a measured phone FPS improvement or fully explain the progressively worsening Nacht lag. No claim is made that the reported lag is fixed. Re-test the affected rounds on the phone.

Optional local diagnostics are off by default. When enabled, they record timings plus memory/thermal information in a local 30-second report for investigation.

## Updating

v4 is a GitHub prerelease for the preview-aware updater in v3. android-v3 remains GitHub Latest/non-prerelease so older v2 installations can update to v3 first. Use Update from v3 or download this release's APK directly. Install over the existing app rather than uninstalling it to retain app data. Actual on-phone upgrade behavior still requires validation.
